economic_mechanism: Own-price persistence after gradual information adjustment; the current fixed forecast and volatility budget are held fixed. This is one bounded implementation/risk-policy test inside the price-persistence mechanism, not a new factor or independent mechanism.
payer_and_failure: Trend followers may receive compensation from slowly adjusting or hedging flows, but competing fast participants and mean reversion can remove it. No current input identifies counterparties, so payer explanation remains a hypothesis. Whipsaw, crowded reversals, funding drag and forced exits can falsify the netedge.
